coverage_gaps: No route from the real M1 to the desktop for camera or LiDAR data. Public GENISOM SDK v0.2.2 has no image, stream, point-cloud or map API; its only camera call is UpdateCameraBitrate. RTSP, Nav-host ROS2 topics or SSH access are undocumented. This blocks every perception/VLN/agent topic until solved or a self-mounted RGB-D + Jetson is budgeted.

Robot identity and variant are still open. 'LTR' does not appear on the GENISOM M1 page. Per that page, the 4 fisheye + stereo 720-degree suite belongs to M1 Ultra and UWB/LiDAR-vision following to Pro. Base-M1 sensors are unknown, and wheel versus point foot changes which topics fit.

The GPU on this host is shared. At check time (2026-10-19 18:13) the RTX 5060 was at 100% util, 87 C and 124 W, with 6.1 of 8.0 GB used by vLLM (4.5 GB), AI2-THOR CloudRendering, Xorg/browsers and an unrelated SIL container. The 6.27 GiB-free budget does not hold unless the machine is dedicated.

NeurIPS 2026 accepted papers (notified 2026-09-24) were not swept for novelty. The official listing has concurrent work: EVT with lightweight VLA, multi-robot shared understanding, FocusNav, Image2Sim, RAO-Nav (audio-visual), Proactive Instance Navigation, and Vision to Geometry 3D spatial memory. CVPR 2027 counts work posted before 2026-09-15 as prior.

Embodied visual tracking and person following are missing. They are the natural quadruped task, and NeurIPS 2026 has 'Long-term Embodied Visual Tracking with Lightweight VLA Models' plus (local list) Follow-Bench 2.0. EVT benchmarks and protocols were not surveyed.

LiDAR-centric embodied perception and language grounding are not covered. M1 Pro/Ultra carry LiDAR, but the nav/agents/perception sweeps assume RGB-D plus pose. Open-vocabulary LiDAR mapping, LiDAR-VLM grounding and LiDAR localization with VL priors (ViLo, NeurIPS 2026 local list) went unexamined.

Outdoor/urban legged navigation and audio-visual navigation got little coverage, even though the M1 is IP67 and the Pro has a mic and speaker. Missing: UrbanNav (AAAI-26), AURA shared autonomy (CVPR 2026), RAO-Nav zero-shot semantic audio-visual nav (NeurIPS 2026), and SoundSpaces-style benchmarks.

No sim-to-real plan for quadruped navigation. Habitat agents use discrete actions at wheeled-robot camera height, while the M1 takes normalized Move() velocities held 1 s at 10-20 Hz. Nobody mapped Habitat or MATRiX actions to Move(), measured camera height/pitch on the dog, or proposed a sim-vs-real correlation protocol.

The ROS2 bridge is unverified. The SDK lists no ROS2 support. RoamerX (ROS2 Humble, Ubuntu 22.04) has only TODO hardware-deployment docs and needs a root-run 'robot-forward' .deb plus rmw_zenoh. On a 20.04 host this needs Humble/Jazzy containers. No end-to-end SDK-to-ROS2 topic path has been tested.

No data-collection setup has been designed: rosbag2/MCAP logging, clock sync between robot and desktop, ground truth (mocap, AprilTag, RTK), consent and privacy for filming people, and CVPR video anonymization. MotionData quaternions are wxyz and ImuData xyzw, a known pitfall.

No M1 simulation asset exists outside MATRiX. Nothing is published for Habitat, Isaac Lab, Genesis or Playground. That MATRiX zgws/zgwt is the user's M1 is a guess (the preview filename zsm-1w is only an image). Locomotion or loco-nav topics need a Go2/Go2-W proxy, which weakens real-robot claims.

No timeline tying topic to venue. CVPR 2027 is due 2026-11-16 (4 weeks away, no results yet). ICCV 2027 and ACM MM 2027 deadlines are unannounced (the 2027.acmmm.org page is a placeholder). The school's recognized-venue list (认定目录; TH-CPL ranks RSS/ICRA as A) and whether the NeurIPS E&D track counts are both unchecked.

Local planner capability is unmeasured above 2B. Only Qwen3-VL-2B was measured on sm_120. 4B/8B int4 or FP8 are estimates, and WMNav-style SR collapses at 3B (29.7 vs 46.1 for 7B). Whether a local-only planner is viable, or a cloud API (DashScope) is required, is undecided.

Vendor and competition protocols were not explored. MATRiX ships IROSFlatWorld2025, IROSSloppedWorld2025, CrowdWorld and 3DGSWorld maps, and GENISOM claims Yizhuang challenge results. These could supply ready-made legged evaluation scenes and baselines.

contradictions: CCF ranks. nav.ccf_venue_note says the CCF-A AI conferences include IJCAI and that ICLR is not A. That comes from the stale 6th-edition web page. Every other researcher and the official 7th-edition PDF give ICLR A and IJCAI B.

ICLR 2026 papers. nav labels DualVLN 'ICLR 2026 (not in CCF AI A list)' and NavFoM 'venue unknown'. venues and venue_sweep treat NavFoM, DualVLN and CE-Nav as ICLR 2026 CCF-A, and the proceedings confirm NavFoM.

Quadruped papers. loco says no AAAI/CVPR 2025-26 quadruped papers were found. venues lists ODYSSEY and legged-manipulator grasping (AAAI-26); venue_sweep lists OneOcc (CVPR 2026) and CityWalker on Go1 (CVPR 2025).

AAAI coverage. venue_sweep says AAAI 2025/2026 was not swept, yet the local my_titles/aaai2026.tsv holds AAAI-26 titles including 2 legged ones. Its '1 of ~44.8k' legged base rate is therefore an undercount.
Playground JAX build. compute's recommended venv B uses jax[cuda13] 0.11.2 for Playground, but loco and the Playground README specify jax[cuda12]. Playground was never run on this host.
Isaac Sim on Ubuntu 20.04. compute says no native route, container only. The Isaac Lab install page suggests pre-built Isaac Sim binaries 'for instance, on Ubuntu 20.04'; only pip is glibc-blocked.

M1 sensors. robot lists '4 fisheye + forward stereo' as general official sensors, but the official page attributes them to M1 Ultra. robot also says the SDK has camera take-photo APIs; the SDK docs have only UpdateCameraBitrate.

Real-robot inputs. nav, agents and perception assume RGB-D plus pose from the robot (DualVLN used a D455; HOV-SG and GraphEQA need posed RGB-D). The robot SDK provides no image or depth stream, so these deployment plans have no data source yet.
Free VRAM. compute measured 6.27 GiB free, but my check found 6.1 of 8 GB already used by other processes (vLLM, AI2-THOR) at 100% util.

Name collision. 'EmbodiedSplat' refers to two different papers: ICCV 2025 phone-3DGS real-to-sim (nav, venue_sweep) and CVPR 2026 online feed-forward semantic 3DGS (perception). Cite with venue to avoid confusion.

Whitespace claims overlap with existing work. venue_sweep and perception claim no camera-height or quadruped-viewpoint benchmark and no legged social-nav benchmark. nav cites GVNav and VLN-PE on low viewpoints, agents cites GangnamLoop and GuideDogQA, and the local NeurIPS 2026 list has Follow-Bench 2.0.
DIRECT venue. agents lists DIRECT as an arXiv Jun 2026 preprint; arXiv v2 now says CoRL 2026.
genisom_vln default robot. robot says it is xgb (L-series), but the fetched genisom_vln README does not mention xgb. xgb is MATRiX's default robot, so the two were probably conflated.
HM3D-OVON SOTA. nav cites OVSegDT 44.7 SR as the reference result, while perception cites DRIVE-Nav 50.2 SR / 32.6 SPL. Neither states a common protocol.
followup_research: Confirm the robot from a nameplate or app photo: is it GENISOM 铜锤 M1, and which variant (wheel or point foot; Pro, Ultra or Air)? Which system version is it on?

How can raw front/back camera frames and LiDAR point clouds get to the desktop (RTSP, WebRTC, Nav-host ROS2 topics, SSH)? If none, what does a self-mounted RGB-D camera plus Jetson on the 12/24/48 V payload rail cost?
Ask GENISOM's 万有引力计划 for an M1 URDF/MJCF, low-level joint access, and confirmation that MATRiX zgws/zgwt matches the user's M1.
Measure end-to-end loop latency on the real dog (camera, Wi-Fi/Ethernet, RTX 5060 VLM, Move() at 10-20 Hz) plus camera height and pitch before choosing a latency-aware or viewpoint-aware topic.

Sweep all NeurIPS 2026 accepted papers (main plus E&D, all 3 sites) and arXiv Jun-Oct 2026 against each shortlisted topic. Concurrent nav work includes FocusNav, Image2Sim, InfoNav, LangMap, EVT-VLA and Vision to Geometry.
Benchmark Qwen3-VL-4B/8B (int4/FP8) and Qwen3.5-4B on sm_120 for VRAM and latency, and run a small HM3D ObjectNav pilot. Is a local-only planner viable, or is DashScope required (and budgeted)?
Pick a realistic venue: ICCV 2027 (~Mar) or ACM MM 2027 (~Apr) versus a rushed CVPR 2027 (Nov 16). Check the school's 认定目录 for ICLR, TMM and NeurIPS E&D, and the TH-CPL treatment of RSS/ICRA.
Secure GPU exclusivity: find out who runs the persistent vLLM, AI2-THOR and simulation workloads on this host, or obtain a second machine or rented GPU for ablations.
Install Habitat-sim (conda nightly) on sm_120 with EGL, obtain HM3D/MP3D licenses, and run one ObjectNav episode. Also verify that MATRiX runs alongside a VLM within 8 GB.
Check whether GangnamLoop, GuideDogQA, Follow-Bench 2.0, QuadOcc or an L4Dog resubmission already cover 'dog-view' perception, memory or social-nav data before proposing a quadruped-view dataset.
For a local/cloud cascade topic, find RACER (cited by StepGate) and other risk-controlled routing papers, and read Sibyl's full results, before claiming novelty.
Design the data protocol: ground truth (AprilTag, mocap or RTK), consent for filming people on campus, dataset licensing, and CVPR anonymization of GENISOM branding in supplementary videos.
